title: Trump Warned of a Depression, Here's What the Options Actually Price
speaker: tastylive host (Options Math Check)

macro_themes.view: Midterm years are the weakest of the cycle but the following period, starting in January, is the strongest.
Split government has historically been good for stocks, so who wins matters less than gridlock.
Options and VIX term structure show no depression or sharp decline priced in.

calls.reason: Options price only ~423-point (≈5%) moves either way to January, no depression; midterm seasonality shows rallies around the vote and the strongest year starting in January, and gridlock historically helps stocks.
calls.quote: The S&P 500 rallied through 21 of 23 midterms with the median gain of 7%.

calls.reason: VIX around 15 with futures in contango (Oct 16.80 < Nov < Dec), so no elevated volatility priced around the midterms.
calls.quote: As of right now, we're not even seeing any expected volatility around those midterm elections.

notes: Host name not stated. Directional views rest on historical seasonality rather than an explicit forecast; conviction low.
